children: Thailand's headline consumer price index (THCPI=ECI) rose 3.90% in October from a year earlier, following an annual increase of 2.82% in the previous month, the commerce ministry said on Friday.
The reading compared with a forecast rise of 3.24% in a Reuters poll, and exceeded the central bank's inflation target range of 1% to 3%.
The core CPI (THCPIX=ECI), which excludes volatile energy and fresh food prices, rose 1.58% in October from a year earlier.
